lede: Every ElevenLabs text to speech plan (ElevenCreative), how many credits each one includes, and the cheapest plan for the audio you make each month.
calc_label: ElevenLabs credits you need each month
calc_note: The calculator compares the ElevenCreative plans, the default tab on ElevenLabs' pricing page, by monthly credits. On the highest quality models 1 text character uses 1 credit, and ElevenLabs puts one minute of audio at about 1,000 characters. Every product, from text to speech to music and dubbing, draws from the same credits. ElevenLabs only gives approximate prices for extra minutes, so the calculator does not add them. Enterprise is custom.
after_plans: Prices exclude taxes. On monthly billing, Starter's first month is $1 and Creator's first month is $11. ElevenLabs lists an approximate price for each extra minute of text to speech: about $0.36 on Free, $0.20 on Starter, $0.18 on Creator and $0.17 on Pro, Scale and Business. Enterprise has custom pricing, with custom SSO, BAAs for HIPAA customers and more seats and voices.

compare.What you pay for: Credits shared by all products: 1 credit per text character on the highest quality models
compare.Free option: Free: 10,000 credits a month, about 10 minutes of speech
compare.Cheapest paid plan: Starter: $6/month, or $5/month billed yearly, for 30,000 credits
compare.Most on a public plan: Business: $990/month, or $825/month billed yearly, for 6,000,000 credits
compare.Usage above the plan: About $0.17 to $0.36 per extra minute of speech, depending on the plan (approximate)

faq: Free is $0 with 10,000 credits a month. Starter is $6/month ($5/month billed yearly) for 30,000 credits, Creator $22/month ($18.33 yearly) for 121,000, Pro $99/month ($82.50 yearly) for 600,000, Scale $299/month ($249.17 yearly) for 1,800,000 and Business $990/month ($825 yearly) for 6,000,000. Enterprise is custom.
How many credits does text to speech use?

On the highest quality models 1 text character costs 1 credit, and one minute of audio is about 1,000 characters. On the Flash and Turbo models, API usage costs between 0.5 and 1 credit per character.

On paid plans, unused credits roll over for up to two months, so your balance can reach 3 times your monthly quota while you keep an active subscription. Downgrading or cancelling forfeits them at the end of the cycle, and the Free plan has no rollover.

Yes. Yearly billing works out to two months free, since you pay 10 months' price for 12. The monthly equivalent is $5 on Starter, $18.33 on Creator, $82.50 on Pro, $249.17 on Scale and $825 on Business.
